title: Shinonome Akito — The World In My Eyes〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Early Morning
Hotel - Cafe Entrance

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (I definitely got up way too early...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (I mean, look at the time. I know the event's happening today, but still...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (I guess I'm more excited than I realized.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Toya and the others won't be up yet.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (So, I guess I could warm up over in SEKAI...)
There you are.
se_walk_men_002_1

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You're already here, Toya?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: You were gone when I woke up, so I figured that you'd be waiting here. You've gotten up quite early.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Look who's talking.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I just couldn't help but wake up.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I suppose I'm more excited about today's event than I realized.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Is something wrong?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: No, I just realized that we're both in the same boat.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
I see.
To be fair, I feel like we have every right to be excited.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: It's not every day that you get to see an event over here in the United States.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Especially not a huge one like this.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, and all the artists are huge names in their respective genres.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I can't really imagine what it's gonna be like.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Still, the event's not until evening, so there really wasn't any point waking up this early.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: True, it's still early for us to meet up. Should we wait here for Shiraishi and Azusawa, or begin practicing on our own?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I was just thinking about going over to SEKAI to start warming up. We can text them or—
se_walk_women_002_1
se_walk_women_002_2

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Huh?
Shinonome? Aoyagi? You're both already awake?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Hey, look at that.
Don't tell me, you're so excited for the event that you couldn't stay in bed?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, basically.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, and look who else is up early.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
It's true, we both woke up earlier than normal.
We were talking about getting a head start on practice.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: This reminds me of when I was in elementary school.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I always woke up super early the day of field trips and stuff because of how excited I was.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah, it is hard to stay asleep when you know it's a special day.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: In any case, it's good that we're all motivated.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: And since we're all awake, let's start practice a little early.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Hehe. I have a good feeling about today!
I'm gonna sing my heart out right from the beginning!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Alright, settle down. Being excited is fine and all, but we need to warm up first.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Anyway, let's go.
